declare
 temp_max_seq_no number;
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_tb_id VARCHAR2(14);
 null_value VARCHAR2(1):='';
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 -- Generate tb_seq_no
 begin
 begin
 select nvl(tb_seq,1000)+1
 into temp_tb_id
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0090');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update chapters
 set tb_seq = temp_tb_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('2');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_tb_id := to_char(sysdate,'MMDDRR')||'-NT'||temp_tb_id;
 end;
 -- Insert new batch into test batch hdr
 begin
 insert into test_batch_hdr
 (tb_id,test_chapter_id,group_test_id,user_id,
 insert_dats, first_unit_id, last_unit_id,
 repeat_flag, start_work_number)
 values
 (temp_tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :group_test_id,
 :banner.user_id, sysdate, :unit_id, :unit_id, 'N', '5000');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('1');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- Insert new batch into test batch detail for every test
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 -- go_record('1');
 --loop
 begin
 insert into test_batch_det
 (tb_id,test_chapter_id,test_id,
 test_type, testing_lab_code)
 values
 (temp_tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,
 'A', :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 --message('1.1');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 /* if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;*/
 end;
 --
 begin
 -- go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 --go_record('1');
 --loop
 -- Update last unit ID in test_batch_hdr
 begin
 update test_batch_hdr
 set last_unit_id = :unit_id
 where tb_id = temp_tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- Calling database procedure for updating test results
 temp_return_val := test_results.update_auto_test(
 :unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,
 null_value, null_value,
 null_value, 'ANT', temp_tb_id,
 :banner.prog_name, sysdate);
 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 --message('CORE routine for test results not run successfully');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('3500');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 /*if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;*/
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and donor_decision_code = 'S'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id := '';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 donor_decision_code = 'S' and 
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 -- there cannot be situation where the
 -- chapter_id is not there but the collection
 -- date is there
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id is null
 then
 --message('Unit has not been checked-in...');
 show_error('0012');
 check_package_failure; 
 else
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id and
 nvl(coll_date,sysdate) =
 nvl(:coll_date,sysdate) and
 result_status_1 is null and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0165');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;
